cells.title: When the model works
cells.story: Physarum's own max-flux walk reaches the optimum both before and after five path edges close, and so does ACO.

cells.title: When the answer is really Dijkstra's
cells.story: Before the closure Physarum's own walk finds the route. After it, the warm walk dead-ends and the full-graph fallback, which is plain Dijkstra, supplies a perfect-looking answer in a single iteration.

cells.title: When both methods go wrong
cells.story: Both bio-inspired methods converge confidently onto routes that are shorter in hops but slower: geometrically direct corridors that are exactly the congested ones.
